description: Listing title with a category dropdown that filters the cards-listing block on the same page.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: title and category filter for a cards-listing

contentPattern.structure: a row with the listing heading (e.g. Tourist Places), then an optional row "Filter" | comma-separated categories (or a list). Without the options row the dropdown lists the categories found on the cards-listing cards; an "All" entry is always first

reuseGuidance: Place directly above a cards-listing block. It filters every cards-listing on the page by the cards' Category line; it has no effect on other blocks.
